sourceLabel: Springer Nature 出版商通用准备
description: 覆盖标题、摘要、关键词、声明和投稿材料的出版商级准备；具体期刊说明仍优先。
descriptionEn: Covers publisher-level preparation for titles, abstracts, keywords, declarations, and submission materials; journal instructions still take precedence.

submissionElements.label: 论文标题
submissionElements.description: 核对标题准确、简洁并包含便于检索的核心术语。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that the title is accurate, concise, and includes useful search terms.

submissionElements.label: 作者与单位
submissionElements.description: 核对作者顺序、单位、通讯作者和期刊匿名要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify author order, affiliations, corresponding author, and journal anonymization rules.

submissionElements.label: 摘要
submissionElements.description: 核对摘要覆盖主要研究内容并符合文章类型和期刊结构。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that the abstract covers the main study and matches article-type and journal structure.

submissionElements.label: 关键词
submissionElements.description: 核对关键词具体、可检索并符合期刊数量要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that keywords are specific, discoverable, and within the journal's count requirements.

submissionElements.label: 资助声明
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify funding sources and grant identifiers.

submissionElements.label: 利益冲突声明
submissionElements.description: 核对利益冲突声明及期刊指定标题。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the competing-interest statement and journal-specified heading.

submissionElements.label: 数据可用性声明
submissionElements.description: 按具体期刊政策说明数据位置与访问条件。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: State data location and access conditions under the journal policy.

submissionElements.label: 伦理批准
submissionElements.description: 涉及人或动物研究时核对委员会、编号和适用声明。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: For human or animal research, verify committee, identifier, and applicable statement.

submissionElements.label: 发表同意
submissionElements.description: 涉及可识别个人信息时核对发表同意。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify consent for publication when identifiable personal information is included.

submissionElements.label: 作者贡献声明
submissionElements.description: 核对具体期刊采用的作者贡献方式。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the contribution format used by the selected journal.

submissionElements.label: 投稿附信
submissionElements.description: 核对具体期刊是否要求及其内容。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify whether the selected journal requires a cover letter and what it must contain.

submissionElements.label: 图表与题注
submissionElements.description: 核对图表文件、题注、分辨率和正文引用。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify figure/table files, captions, resolution, and in-text citations.

submissionElements.label: 补充材料
submissionElements.description: 核对补充文件、命名和正文引用。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify supplementary files, naming, and citations in the manuscript.

rules.message: 请核对具体 Springer Nature 期刊的文章类型、匿名方式、声明和附件要求。
rules.messageEn: Check the selected Springer Nature journal's article type, anonymization, declarations, and attachments.
